question: A free 1 km steel rail warms 40 °C. Steel grows by 12 millionths of its length per degree. How many cm longer?
move: Anything that cannot grow will push; plan for where the push goes.
trap: Assuming stiff steel could only grow by a few millimetres.
hint: Work out the growth for one degree first, then scale up.
reference: Esveld, Modern Railway Track, 2nd edition, MRT-Productions, 2001
